About

I’m Luis Sanchez, an aspiring product manager who approaches painful user problems with clear plans for teams to build. I’m an extremely curious person who always asks “why?” I’m also analytically driven and back every decision with data. As a collaborative teammate, I bring designers, engineers, and stakeholders to the same table and onto the same page so we can combine our ideas and move toward our goals. If you’re looking for someone who can help your team ship products people love, I’d love to talk.

Featured case study

Extracting Social Determinants of Health from Social Worker Notes

Role: Undergraduate Researcher, co-authorTeam: Harjith Pradeep, Luis Sanchez, Zhe HeProgram: FSU UROP · eHealth LabTools: Python, BioBERT, RoBERTa, LLMs

1. Problem

Social determinants of health, like income, education, and social support, account for up to 40% of preventable deaths, yet they are often missing from electronic health records. Models trained without them make biased predictions.

2. Process & Research

We worked with social work experts and a University of Florida annotator to write a two-level annotation guideline: trigger words first, then context.

3. Solution

We trained transformer models to extract trigger words, then passed the matching sentences to large language models for deeper context.

4. Results (level-one tags)

17SDoH categories in the guideline
0.78BioBERT F1, strict match
0.80BioBERT F1, sentence level
0.84RoBERTa precision, sentence level

Artifact: annotation guideline excerpt showing how a trigger word gets a first-level tag and a second-level status.

Artifact: precision, recall, and F1 for BioBERT and RoBERTa under strict, relaxed, and sentence-level matching.

5. Lessons Learned

Performance fell short of our goals, likely because the guideline is detailed and has many categories. Next, we’ll improve how the models adapt to the data and refine the annotation strategy. The product lesson: a richer framework gives users more value, but it raises the bar for the model, so scope and quality have to be balanced.
